context_requirements: Myorelaxants act on smooth or skeletal muscle contractile machinery (e.g., calcium channels, ryanodine receptors, GABA-A receptors, adrenergic receptors) or on neuromuscular junction signaling
The nine lines are non-muscle transformed lines (melanoma, lung, kidney, liver, colon, breast, prostate) with no evidence of functional muscle contractile apparatus or neuromuscular junction
No annotated molecular targets are listed for this class in the Drug Repurposing Hub, so no direct transcriptional program can be assigned
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h shared across multiple lines
Induction of a coherent muscle-specific or calcium-signaling transcriptional program
Any line showing moderate or strong magnitude response
